# V2 artifact sidecar UX review, round 3

Verdict: **PASS within the static sidecar workflow scope**. Zero actionable findings. Both previously reported P2 issues are corrected in the frozen source. This verdict provides no Rust execution, SDK capture, native UI, full application, full workspace CI, or parity completion credit.

Reviewed `/workspace/android-studio-source-providers`, base `ac58815bb268d338bea40a31fff630734cd719f4`, immutable freeze `review-source-snapshot-round3.json`. Re-read the complete current production module, changed bridge, all new regressions and differences from frozen round2 against the task/pinned reference contracts. Existing applicable rules and cloud runtime skill remain applied; current environment observations report connected/running. No Cargo, Gradle, application, SDK probe, source or cache edit, branch mutation, or subagent was run. Only this external report was written.

## Previous findings resolved

1. The SDK null-collection/map issue remains fixed at `project_model.gradle:308`,313 and317. Mandatory values are validated as Collection/Map before collect, inside per-getter captured boundaries. Null/wrong type yields explicit Unavailable with the exact capability and failure detail; a valid empty value remains available-empty. Nullable artifact slots, actual absent artifacts, and nullable Android task names are preserved. All new sidecar collections/maps use the guards. The Rust null/empty regression is present at tests702. Actual Groovy/Gradle negative boundary execution remains required before runtime credit.
2. Positional array envelopes are now rejected by `ObjectOnly` (`generated_artifacts.rs:37`) routing object deserialization to the underlying deserialize_map. GeneratedRecord's explicit trait entry passes through that guard (`generated_artifacts.rs:822`), so `[valid_sidecar]` cannot reach successful schema/model validation. The same object-only entry is applied to nested DTOs and adjacent-tagged CapturedField/ArtifactSlot objects. This avoids an untested alternate positional shape in producer/consumer/row/slot facts. The new test at tests766 covers the exact reported top-level shape plus nested producer, minimum consumer, named model version, generated classpath row, captured-field and artifact-slot arrays.

ObjectOnly restricts the root of the particular wire object. The underlying MapAccess supplies native field deserializers: Vec fields still accept the required JSON arrays; Option task fields still accept allowed null; scalar version/string/path fields retain native decoding. The fix does not reinterpret legitimate SDK list content as objects or duplicate the schema manually. Remote derive helpers preserve field names, tagged statuses, defaults and unknown-field rejection, while explicit Deserialize trait entries enforce the object boundary.

## Observable model outcomes checked

- Public Basic parser and original import sources/tests/fixtures remain unchanged. Sidecar parsing is independent; missing or failed artifact transport cannot erase a caller's valid Basic model. No UI import consumer, widget, shortcut, or menu was added.
- Legacy records without generatedArtifacts produce MissingMetadata for the sidecar; explicit-null/malformed records, multiple model lines, unknown sidecar fields and invalid shapes are rejected explicitly. Unsupported transport schema, too-old minimum consumer, unavailable minimum-consumer capability, absent selected variant and stale model/revision remain typed outcomes.
- Available-empty folders/maps, artifact absence, unavailable getters, and Java-only Android NotApplicable fields stay distinct. Getter and variant identities are retained; Java Android task fields cannot masquerade as available-null or unavailable tasks.
- Generated source/resource/assets folders and classpath JARs remain separate DTO fields. No JAR is copied into Java folders. Ordered vectors preserve SDK encounter order and duplicate paths; duplicate SDK map keys are rejected explicitly instead of silently deduplicated.
- Raw official outside-build paths remain raw modeled paths, with presence/trust handled separately. Normalized absolute-path requirements reject malformed dot/parent/duplicate-separator/control-character values. There is no scanning, folder-name heuristic, selected-variant guess, source-root grouping, Kotlin-facet inference, or claimed visibility/light-class filtering.
- Model producer>=11.0 assets and producer>=8.9 OR legacy AGP>=8.2.0-alpha07 generated-classpath gates match pinned BasicModules. Older unproved assets/classpath capability returns an explicit error while preserving raw values. Version descriptions remain identity-bearing and do not affect signed numeric ordering. Both full original ordering test inputs and reversed/sorted/in-order assertion meaning are preserved, with Apache2 reference headers, LICENSE and NOTICE.
- Streaming ignores unrelated Basic fields without materializing their values as part of the artifact DTO, and the unrelated-payload equality regression remains. Linear identity validation retains exact module/directory and variant matching. Neither optimization changes artifact selection semantics.

## Required remaining gates and limits

Actual normal locked full AndroidTools tests, strict repository Clippy, formatting, exact-source official SDK Java/bytecode/custom-field/disabled BuildConfig and null/empty bridge probes remain required. Root's combined full application/native, full workspace CI, source-bound parity capture, lead review and protected merge gates remain required separately.

The other ModelVersions method and five original generated-tree model/file/refresh/UI flows remain unported. Raw V2 transport does not complete Studio generated-root/light-class/KAPT policy, Kotlin facet equivalence, an integrated Android tree, or any UI fidelity claim. No parity row was changed and this PASS adds no original-test completion credit.
